# Rule 5 - Do not powergame
Powergaming is displaying a pattern of antisocial and/or unsporting behavior in which one prioritizes personal experience at the expense of others. This can include, but is not limited to the following:
\n
- Do not use exploits, cheats, or external programs to gain an unfair advantage or disrupt the server in any way.
- Do not use Metacommunication to give yourself an advantage over other players, or gain information you would not otherwise have.
- Do not share current round information, but you're free to play alongside others in call.
- Do not engage with more than one UIV per spawned flotilla.
